_comment: TikTok browser-automation posting settings. Cookies come from exporting your logged-in browser session (Netscape format) to data/cookies.txt - see scripts/setup.ps1 step 6. headless: TikTok's bot detection is stricter; keep false for reliable posting. upload_timeout_sec: seconds allowed for page loads during upload (homepage/auth + upload page); raise it if the heavy TikTok pages load slowly. user_agent: keep this a recent desktop Chrome UA - the library default (Chrome 58) gets connection-reset by TikTok's WAF. retry_wait_*: exponential backoff applied between upload attempts after each failure.
